key_insight: Domain shift in Video Temporal Grounding fails mainly because visual domain differences break the link between an MLLM's temporal localization knowledge and its entity-attention; anchoring grounding in entity-grounded visual evidence restores that coupling and improves cross-domain robustness.
problem_solved: Fine-tuned MLLMs for Video Temporal Grounding perform well in-domain but degrade sharply under visual domain shift; the paper addresses how to adapt MLLMs efficiently so they preserve temporal localization abilities when visuals differ.
method: Introduce EVIDENT: a parameter-efficient adaptation framework that routes adaptation through entity-grounded visual evidence to anchor temporal grounding.

Use lightweight adaptation modules (e.g., adapters / LoRA / prompt layers) and a routing mechanism that links entity mentions in queries to visual evidence across frames, enabling the model to fuse entity-attention with temporal localization.
Train the routing/evidence modules to select and emphasize cross-domain visual cues so temporal grounding generalizes without full fine-tuning of the MLLM.
impact: Enables practical, low-cost adaptation of large multimodal models for robust video temporal grounding across domains, reducing full fine-tuning needs and improving reliability in real-world, varied visual settings.
visual_elements: Architecture diagram: MLLM backbone + lightweight adapters + routing module that links query entities to selected video frames
Before/After bar chart: in-domain vs out-of-domain VTG accuracy showing degradation with naive fine-tuning and recovery with EVIDENT
Timeline visualization: video frames annotated with entity-grounded heatmap highlighting selected evidence and predicted temporal interval
Flowchart: routing process from query entity → evidence retrieval/selection → adapter-guided localization
paper_title: EVIDENT: Routing MLLM Adaptation through Entity-Grounded Visual Evidence for Cross-Domain Video Temporal Grounding
paper_authors: Geo Ahn, Jiwook Han, Youngrae Kim, Joonseok Lee, Jinwoo Choi
